title: Garmin rolls out new feature updates for select smartwatches and cycling computers
summary: Garmin today announced several new software and feature updates for select smartwatches, including the fēnix® 8 series, Forerunner® 570 and Forerunner 970, Venu® 4 and vívoactive® 6, as well as compatible Edge® cycling computers.
